baseline_provenance.working_tree: includes the preexisting WIP snapshot; not pristine main

measurement: Elapsed steady_clock wall time inside World.tick, not process CPU time; independent serial cases in externally coordinated quiet window; no profile/allocation/trace overhead
arrival: legal full footprint at each of 30 exact stationary ticks, alive, empty orders, zero speed, within fixed authored area; -1 means censored
limits: No warmup samples discarded. World.tick timing excludes fixture mutation and observers.
Same harness and optimization/static-runtime flags for frozen and candidate libraries.
Map dimensions vary with population. Population controls are 1200 ticks; main cases are 6000 ticks.
Only the open-2000 case was repeated (three runs, including reverse order).
Retail+ bytes and search scratch bytes are retained capacities at observation, not independently measured allocator peaks.
RSS is whole-process high-water memory, not pathfinding-only memory.
Synthetic bridge fixture is a long narrow ground corridor, not a retail water crossing.

visuals.description: Geometry-only plots of actual sampled positions; not rendered gameplay.
